title_zh: The natural world — 第3节可背诵讲义
body_en: The natural world is full of small surprises. Birds sing near the river. Trees give cool cover on hot days. If we keep parks clean, animals can find food and quiet places. Look carefully: a leaf, a cloud, a fish in clear water — each one tells a short story. Protect nature with small acts: pick up rubbish, save water, plant one tree.
body_zh: 自然世界充满小惊喜。鸟在河边歌唱。大树在热天送来阴凉。如果我们保持公园干净，动物就能找到食物和安静的地方。仔细看：一片叶子、一朵云、清水里的鱼——每一件都在讲短故事。用小事保护自然：捡垃圾、节水、种一棵树。
